method: Built-in image_gen.imagegen; reference-guided generation/editing. Generated alpha preserved in WebP conversion.

assets.prompt: Create a finished portrait FRONT COVER illustration for an original superhero comic titled VOLT. Match the supplied reference's established character and detailed contemporary Western superhero comic visual language: expressive heavy black ink contours, fine crosshatching, angular anatomy, dramatic foreshortening, rich flat colour with painterly shadow planes, blue electricity and warm city lights. Reference is for character design and art style ONLY, not a panel layout to copy. Single portrait cover, full bleed, no collage or interior panels, no speech bubbles. Show Volt, an original young adult MALE neighbourhood protector, leaping forward above a dense rain-dark city rooftop, one electrified hand thrust forward, determined warm heroic energy. He wears the EXACT reference black fitted suit with bright electric-blue circuit seams, silver-white angular shoulder/forearm armour and helmet: swept black crest, silver swept fins, glowing blue V-shaped visor, angular silver jaw; full helmet, no exposed hair or face, no red, no spider motif. The skyline below hints at the shielded Fortress and danger in the city, while focus stays entirely on Volt. This should look like an actual issue-one comic cover. Large carefully drawn masthead text at top reads exactly 'VOLT', bold angular ivory letters edged in black and electric blue; small upper-left issue box reads '#1'. No other printed text, no logos, no artist signatures. Leave the illustration properly composed beneath the title with enough negative sky around the masthead. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio. Complete uncut artwork edge-to-edge. Deliver the cover straight-on as flat artwork, not photographed on a table and not an angled physical book.

Edit this Fortress game environment painting to make the real room entrances visually unmistakable. Keep the exact 1484 by 1060 composition and camera, detailed inked superhero-comic style, nighttime city windows, central holographic table, upper-left greenhouse, left workshop, lower-left bunk, lower-right training room, bottom-centre deploy gateway. No people. This is a playable walkable map, so the floor passages must be truly clear in the illustration. PRIORITY 1: the lower-left bunk entrance. Remove the cabinets, tall shelf, boxes or other furniture along the right edge of the bunk room between image coordinates x350..460 and y670..925, and paint an unmistakable OPEN DOORWAY and broad stone-floor passage entering the bunk from the central hall around x440,y700 and continuing left/down to the rug at x300,y875. Do not leave any shelf standing across this passage. Place any relocated cupboard against the far-left wall. PRIORITY 2: the armoury on the right. Replace the leftmost equipment display cabinet near x1040,y430 with a real open doorway in a dark riveted wall, warm lights on both doorposts, visibly showing the interior weapons racks beyond. A clear horizontal floor passage enters at x1020,y555 and continues to x1270,y545; the doorway must be tall enough to read as architecture, not a floor icon. Keep the remaining gear displays lining the room's back wall and leave the entire aisle unobstructed. Also emphasize the lower-right training room's entrance at x1035,y707 with a matching open arch and a clear floor gap, and preserve the greenhouse and workshop access. Thick black ink, warm brass sconces, blue tech, worn rugs, gothic-industrial architecture. All door thresholds should visually join the floor on both sides, no hovering gates or opaque filled doorway. No labels or text baked into art, no arrows, no UI markers. Preserve all important objects away from requested passages.

Create one empty playable ARMOURY TRAINING ROOM background for this same superhero Fortress. Reference image establishes the exact visual style and architecture: detailed hand-inked Western superhero comic artwork, thick and fine black contours and crosshatching, blue-gray stone floor slabs, gothic-industrial riveted walls, warm amber sconces and small electric blue technology, nighttime city beyond high arched windows. Landscape ratio 1500:790, fixed elevated three-quarter camera just like the reference. This is a separate room inside the same Fortress, not a rooftop. Interior area: an expansive EMPTY central stone-floored sparring space with an elegant worn red-brown training rug and concentric painted gold practice circles centered at x750,y395. IMPORTANT: no robot, no dummy, no people or enemy figures painted into the background: these will be moving game sprites. Clear empty walking floor from x230 to1270 and y200 to700; all props must remain along outer walls/perimeter. Personality: Patch's messy repair station with wires, tools, notes and a coffee mug against the upper-left wall; five distinct weapon display alcoves along the upper wall; a chalkboard with unreadable training sketches and old impact marks; spare armour/gauntlets on upper-right racks; torn training banners and worn punching bags along far edges only. An unmistakable OPEN EXIT DOORWAY centered in the bottom wall at x750,y735 leads back into the Fortress hall, with warm light on both jambs and blue floor strip continuing through the threshold. No furniture or wall blocks this exit path. Leave floor in bottom center completely clear, make the room's floor extend to image edges at bottom doorway. No readable words or labels, no UI, no speech bubbles. Match the illustrated Fortress rather than vector geometry or photorealistic 3D.

Create a single game sprite of an original non-sentient superhero TRAINING ROBOT on a truly transparent background. Detailed hand-inked contemporary Western superhero comic rendering, heavy clean black contours, fine crosshatching, angular warm gray and dark navy metal plates, modest blue status lights and brass fasteners, scuffed rubber contact padding. A friendly purposeful workshop-built training automaton by Patch, not a combat villain. Full body completely visible including both feet, broad stable humanoid torso, rounded head with one soft cyan visor, circular faded red-and-cream target marking on chest, articulated arms with one padded forearm raised in a readable sparring stance, no held weapon. Elevated three-quarter game camera viewed from front-left; feet standing on a floor implied only by pose, NO floor, NO background, NO shadow plate, no border. Match the supplied comic art and Fortress engineering language. Vertical portrait sprite centered with at least 12% transparent space on every side, no cropping of shoulders/hands/feet. No readable text or logos.

Game environment prop sprite atlas: FOUR different ordinary ROOFTOP STORAGE CRATES in a strict 2 by 2 grid on a truly transparent background, equal-sized cells with wide transparent gutters. Each cell has one complete prop centered with its base at the same height. Top-left: weathered wooden packing crate with black metal corner braces. Top-right: low battered blue-gray steel tool chest with latch. Bottom-left: insulated maintenance supply box with faded orange paint and straps. Bottom-right: dark brown timber equipment crate with worn tape, bundled cables tucked beside its base. No coins, no gems, NO letters, no 'CR', no currency markings, no printed symbols, no readable text, no magical glow. These must look like believable objects left by maintenance workers beside rooftop vents and walls. Elevated three-quarter game camera, front and right side and top visible. Match the reference environment's detailed hand-inked Western superhero comic style: heavy black contour, angular linework, rich painted shadow planes, textured wood and scraped industrial metal, restrained cool rooftop palette warmed by subtle amber reflected light. Not pixel art, not flat vector blocks, not cartoon loot chests. No ground plane and no opaque or semi-opaque painted background; alpha outside each prop must be zero. All props fully contained in their cells with at least 15% transparent margin.
